factual_findings: The workflow `.github/workflows/shorts-cdc-source-audit.yml` suffers from execution bottlenecks and a 100% failure rate due to unhandled step failures and unconstrained job runtimes.

hypotheses: Applying `timeout-minutes: 10`, `actions/cache`, and `nick-fields/retry` (max 3 attempts) in `.github/workflows/shorts-cdc-source-audit.yml` will stabilize the job and eliminate the 100% failure rate.
result.recommendation: Update `.github/workflows/shorts-cdc-source-audit.yml` to set `timeout-minutes: 10` at the job level, add an `actions/cache` step prior to dependency installation, and wrap the flaky audit execution step with `nick-fields/retry` configured for 3 attempts.
